purpose: Canonical future-dataset architecture. Defines the dataset unit around a financial situation/event, the metadata schema (kept strictly separate from the locked 18-field production IR), and the mixture specification. No dataset is generated in Phase G.

dataset_unit.concept: one unit = one financial situation, not one document; a unit may reference related-document context but always expects exactly one 18-field IR (or an honest abstention) as the semantic output

metadata_schema.note: dataset metadata NEVER enters the production IR; it selects, balances and evaluates examples

required.expected_status: VERIFIED | REVIEW_REQUIRED | BLOCKED | UNSUPPORTED (fail-closed vocabulary from capability registry)
required.leakage_group: paraphrase/variant group id - variants of one situation never straddle splits

optional.jurisdiction: e.g. IN, US, international (default IN per corpus lineage)
optional.framework: e.g. FYJC/Ind AS vocabulary, generic double-entry
optional.difficulty: easy | medium | hard (defined by ambiguity/conflict count, not vibes)
optional.evidence_refs: spans/offsets into raw_input backing each populated field

mixture_specification.principle: balance along dimensions, not fixed percentages; each dimension has a guardrail target for Phase H batch planning

dimensions.guardrail: no single family >35% of corpus (current corpus: payment family is ~74% of tagged rows - the exact failure Phase H corrects)
dimensions.coverage: all 24 ontology families represented; gap=true families represented PRIMARILY as abstention/REVIEW_REQUIRED examples

dimensions.guardrail: bank_narration <=40%; every CANDIDATE input type represented
dimensions.coverage: narration, journal description, invoice/bill text, receipt-OCR noise, payment webhooks, email text
difficulty derived from ambiguity/conflict class count

dimensions.guardrail: >=25% of examples carry at least one defensive class
dimensions.coverage: all 20 defensive classes, with model_invention_traps and unverifiable_claims over-weighted vs natural frequency
every UNSUPPORTED kernel family gets paired supported-neighbor examples to sharpen the boundary
event vs settlement vs statement dates

dimensions.guardrail: majority IN per existing corpus; international slice for framework-neutral cases
dimensions.coverage: no jurisdiction-specific field semantics added - contract is locked

dimensions.guardrail: every SUPPORTED kernel/formula capability has >=N positive examples; every UNSUPPORTED/PLANNED capability has abstention examples
dimensions.coverage: derived from capability_registry.json - the registry IS the coverage checklist

mixture_specification.scalability: unit + metadata schema are generator-agnostic: 10K -> 100K -> 1M+ scales by generating more units along the same dimensions; ontology and schema do not change

phase_h_must_not: add fields or enum values to the 18-field IR
generate before defensive/abstention classes are represented
let one event family dominate (payment skew is the measured baseline failure)
put dataset metadata inside the production IR
